# @three-ws/avatar-stream

> Progressive 3D over plain HTTP. Pack a GLB into a layered A3S stream whose first 50 KB is already a complete, skinned, spec-valid avatar, then refine it in place with byte-range requests. No custom server, no WebSocket, no new codec.

@three-ws/avatar-stream is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/avatar-stream`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-stream/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-stream/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/avatar-stream/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/avatar-stream/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
